info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Refinancing Overview API provides a comprehensive view of available mortgage refinance options. Users can retrieve detailed information on various refinance loans, including terms, interest rates, and eligibility criteria. This API is essential for mortgage lenders, financial advisors, and individuals seeking to understand refinancing options. By offering insights into refinancing opportunities, the API assists in informed decision-making and efficient financial planning.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve various refinancing options available for their loans, providing insights into interest rates, terms, and eligibility criteria.

requestBody.description: Request body to initiate a refinance loan operation. Ensure that all required fields in the schema are provided for a successful operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the refinance operations when retrieving loan details. It is a placeholder schema indicating that the body should contain a string.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.title: Loan Refinance Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan refinance process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response returned when a loan refinance operation is performed.
